cases.title: Record visited links to Global History
cases.description: Verify that a visited link is recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Record correct link after server redirect
cases.description: Verify that after a server redirect, the correct link is recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Launch History Link in Browser Window
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a history link causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Delete a history entry
cases.description: Verify that a History entry is successfully deleted when a deletion action is performed on it.

cases.title: Delete Multiple History Entries
cases.description: Verify that multiple History entries can be deleted and are no longer displayed.

cases.title: Clear Global History
cases.description: Verify that the Global History is completely cleared when the clear action is triggered.

cases.title: Group history items by Day
cases.description: Verify that history items are successfully grouped by Day when the Day grouping option is selected.

cases.title: Group history items by Site
cases.description: Verify that history items are successfully grouped by Site when the Site grouping option is selected.

cases.title: Group history items by None
cases.description: Verify that history items are displayed without any grouping when the None option is selected.

cases.title: Sort and reverse-sort history per column
cases.description: Verify that history can be sorted and reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns are resizable to show or hide more of entries.

cases.title: Show and Hide History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns can be successfully shown and hidden.

cases.title: Re-visit recently visited sites via Back and Forward button dropdown menu
cases.description: Verify that recently visited sites can be re-visited by interacting with the Back and Forward button dropdown menu.

cases.title: New Empty Session History File for New Browser Window
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is created for a new browser window.

cases.title: New Empty Session History File for Restart
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is created upon a restart.

opinions.feedback: All requirements have corresponding test cases covering the explicitly stated behaviors, groups, and conditions without any missing gaps or blockers.

All requirements and their corresponding test cases have been thoroughly reviewed. The proposed test cases correctly align with the explicit operations and states defined in the requirements. No blockers, coverage gaps, or redundancies were found.

analysis.analysis: R-073: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: A link is visited. Outcome: It shall be recorded to the Global History. R-074: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: A server redirect occurs. Outcome: The correct link shall be recorded to the Global History. R-075: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: Clicking on a history link. Outcome: It shall be launched in a browser window. R-076: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: Deletion action on a history entry. Outcome: A History entry shall be deleted. R-077: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: Deletion action on multiple history entries. Outcome: Multiple History entries shall be deleted and no longer be displayed. R-078: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: Clear Global History action. Outcome: Global History shall be cleared. R-079: Multiple distinct behaviors, Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: Grouping selection applied. Outcome: History items shall be grouped by Day, Site, or None. R-080: Multiple distinct behaviors, Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: Sorting and reverse-sorting applied per column. Outcome: History shall be sorted and reverse-sorted per column. R-081: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: Resizing history columns. Outcome: History columns shall be resizable to show/hide more of entries. R-082: Multiple distinct behaviors, Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: Show or hide action on history columns. Outcome: History columns shall be shown and hidden. R-083: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: Interaction with Back and Forward button dropdown menu. Outcome: Recently visited sites shall be re-visited via Back and Forward button dropdown menu. R-084: Multiple distinct behaviors, Normal test scenario warranted. Trigger: A new browser window is opened or a restart occurs. Outcome: A new, empty session history file shall be created.
